title: Reconciling cryptic relatedness to drive gene discovery in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/frontotemporal dementia
title_zh: 调和隐性亲缘关系以推动肌萎缩性侧索硬化症/额颞叶痴呆的基因发现
abstract: This scientific commentary refers to ‘Identity-by-descent to resolve reduced penetrance and advance gene discovery in neurodegenerative disease’ by Henden et al. (https://doi.org/10.1093/brain/awag326).
